name: EasyPXE-DNSMasq
post_parameters: -c sed -e s|__UNRAID_IP__|${UNRAID_IP}|g -e s|__SUBNET__|${SUBNET}|g -e s|__HTTP_PORT__|${HTTP_PORT}|g /etc/dnsmasq.conf.template > /etc/dnsmasq.conf && exec dnsmasq -k --conf-file=/etc/dnsmasq.conf --log-facility=-
description: EasyPXE DNSMasq provides proxyDHCP and TFTP services for the EasyPXE network boot stack. It works alongside your existing router DHCP server and supplies PXE boot information to Legacy BIOS and UEFI clients. This container requires host networking because it must receive DHCP broadcasts and provide TFTP and proxyDHCP services.

paths.name: DNSMasq Configuration Template
paths.description: Path to the EasyPXE dnsmasq configuration template.

paths.name: TFTP Boot Files
paths.description: Directory containing the Legacy BIOS and UEFI iPXE bootloader files.

variables.name: Unraid IP
variables.description: Static LAN IP address of the Unraid server.

variables.name: LAN Subnet
variables.description: LAN network address used by proxyDHCP. Enter the network address, not a DHCP range.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: HTTP port used by the EasyPXE Nginx container.
